q1_issues.issue: The negative deontic is encoded as a strength-0 bundle containing (Obligated sk_temper_1) — exactly the negated-obligation form the instruction set rejects for prohibitions, which it routes to (Permitted e) at strength 0.0; as written the atom denies that tempering is required rather than advising against tempering.
The "should" weakening (deontic strength 0.7) leaves no trace anywhere in the parse, so "should not be tempered" is indistinguishable from "must not be tempered".

q2_gaps: negated weak deontic "should not / ought not" — the prohibition rule names only must not / may not / shall not / forbidden, and once the bundle strength is set to 0.0 the 0.7 "should" force has no carrier left
notes: The rest is correct: "this steel" is a demonstrative definite, so its typing atom rightly projects outside the strength-0 bundle, the agentless passive omits the Agent, and tempering is a treatment that changes the object (Patient).
